messages:
mina (sec-audits): Heads up: running a surgical entitlement slimdown next Tue 11:00 PT. Scope: org-admin roles, cross-account KMS grants, vendor principals. Objective: reduce high-risk admin bindings and collect attestation evidence. Will run a small smoke cohort in staging before broader rollout.

diego (engsec): thanks. Whats our safety criteria if a deploy or CI pipeline fails after role tightening?

mina (sec-audits): safety plan = immediate emergency regrant via short-lived admin token (svc-emergency) + documented rollback steps. Well snapshot policies before changes. Runbook v0.2: https://go/runbooks/entitlement-slimdown.

sam (infra): paste the KMS binding extraction query? I'll validate results against the logs replica.

mina (sec-audits): using replica_auditdb (read-only):
```
SELECT principal_id, resource_id, binding_uuid, grantor, ts
FROM kms_acl_events
WHERE source_account <> resource_account AND role_similar_to('admin')
AND NOT meta->>'auto_exempt' = 'true'
ORDER BY ts DESC;
```
Notes: role_similar_to is our helper that normalizes role names. Include vendor principals; exclude auto-exempt svc-accts.

tara (sre): add me to watchlist. Ill monitor request latencies and error spikes. Also propose a 30m post-change observation window for services touching KMS.

owners-bot: attestation tickets created for 18 owners, 6 vendor principals flagged. Owners have 72h to attest before escalation.

diego (engsec): vuln triage: two medium->high regressions were reported during a prior prune when RBAC changes removed a fallback role. We have a hotfix (CFG-507) that introduces a safe-fallback role mapping. Recommend we ensure CFG-507 is deployed to all control planes before prune.

mina (sec-audits): will gate on CFG-507 deployed in all regions. Adding to preflight checklist.

sam (infra): checklist proposal:
- preflight: verify CFG-507 applied; run auto-checker
- build staging cohort (3 services) and snapshot their KMS policies (JSON)
- run kms_acl query + generate owners CSV
- owners-bot opens attestation tickets; attach snapshot and remediation guidance
- apply least-priv template (role-mapper v1) to flagged bindings in staging cohort
- observe 30m (rollback threshold: >0.5% error-rate OR any failing scheduled jobs)
- collect evidence bundle: policy snapshots, logs, attestation replies, diffs

tara (sre): small change: make rollback threshold 0.5% for infra-critical routes, 1% for user-facing. Also run a smoke deploy of a trivial workflow that reads/writes a test secret to validate KMS access.

mina (sec-audits): agreed. Adding tiered thresholds and KV smoke test.

diego (engsec): question: how do we treat group aliases (e.g., owner:payments-team) vs individual owners in the attestation flow? We should not auto-remove when owner is a known group alias.

owners-bot: owners mapping includes group aliases whitelist: payments-team, infra-oncall, platform. Group aliases are treated as valid owners; removal requires explicit group attest or SRE sign-off.

mina (sec-audits): planning a 10-min DR drill during the staging prune to exercise the emergency regrant and runbook clarity. Tara and Sam will simulate a permission regression and then attempt rollback.

tara (sre): Ill schedule the drill and post the scenario. Will include trace and synthetic traffic checks.

sam (infra): final note: capture and store the pre-change KMS policy snapshots in secure-archive with immutable retention for audit. Also tag the PR with reason: "entitlement-slimdown-2026Q2".

mina (sec-audits): thanks everyone. Ill open the PR tomorrow with the target list, attach runbook, snapshots, and owners CSV. Ping me for any objections. :wave:
